retained_foundations.statement: The original D7/Obj/Obj2, Built/BPt and Fc.cls records and their actual dependent equalities. Membership in the stated class is the domain of a universal theorem, not a newly assumed GroupCompatibilityFamily or a claimed common-design existence theorem.

Transport along one equality in a dependent family, equality of identical semilinear maps and polynomial evaluations, quotients by the same kernel, and maxima of finitely many real thresholds. All substantive column and quantitative estimates are inherited numbered human claims, recorded in the proof DAG.

The unchanged D3(3,A)=Des(WithChN(A),3), its actual ChosenE, and FamP.Large at the original TransportedAlt order. Every actual given Extra, local group, degree, orbit representative and valuation normalization is preserved.

Only the arbitrary-class universal original link_g corollary WRS10 retains the original TSel and Duty arguments. The selected built-class producer WRS5-WRS9 does not assume TSel, WPt realization or GroupCompatibilityFamily. Full RecT/TSel is still a distinct requirement of other global arguments.
